delta.note: The document amends PMK 81/2024 only on the use of book value for asset transfers in mergers, consolidations, spin-offs and acquisitions, especially in the context of State-Owned Enterprise (BUMN) restructuring. This concerns corporate income tax and transfer valuation, not PPh 21 for permanent employees. It does not change any rate, threshold, deduction, table or calculation step affecting employee withholding.
